pitSemanticsDefinitions.OBSERVED_AT: The instant the producer first stored the row in production (its first_available_at / ingest time). A dataset's history may use another clock; it is stated in its pitHistoricalClock.
pitSemanticsDefinitions.ANNOUNCEMENT_NEXT_OPEN: The open of the first trading session after the announcement.
pitSemanticsDefinitions.ACCEPTANCE_TIME: SEC EDGAR acceptanceDateTime of the filing (UTC as stated). The fallback for a filing known only by its filing date differs by dataset and is stated in its pitParity (US_EQUITY_PIT_FREE_V1: the next NYSE trading day's 09:30 New York open; SMARTFLOW_U11_UNDERLYING_FACTS: none, known_at null).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.BAR_CLOSE: The bar's own close: a bar is visible only once its interval has ended.
pitSemanticsDefinitions.NEXT_OPEN_SESSION_CLOSE: The close (15:00 CST) of the next open session after the observation date.
pitSemanticsDefinitions.NEXT_TRADING_DAY_0900_CST: 09:00 CST of the next trading day after the data date (Cycle Atlas T2 rule for exchange margin summaries).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.ANNOUNCEMENT_NEXT_DAY_0000: 00:00 CST of the day after the announcement date (V6 research replay for statements; f_ann_date, else ann_date, else the statutory deadline).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.IN_DATE: 00:00 CST of the membership's in_date (V6 research replay for SW2021 membership).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.VISIBLE_PARTIAL_BAR: The forming bar is visible before its interval ends (C17 live reads the last, unfinished kline).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.UNKNOWN: No availability instant can be stated; never treated as known (RESEARCH_LIVE_PARITY_V1 P-6).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.CBOE_NEXT_DAY_0030_ET: Day T is usable from T+1 00:30 New York; live, the file's Last-Modified raises the instant if later (Cycle Atlas NEXT_DAY_0030_ET: worker-cf/src/sources/mpt/us/cboe-put-call.ts:7–9, :16; the RSP/SPY breadth uses the same rule, breadth-series.ts:11, :20).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.CBOE_SAME_DAY_2130_ET: Day T is usable at T 21:30 New York once both Cboe VIX and VIX3M history files carry it; Last-Modified raises it if later (Cycle Atlas SAME_DAY_2130_ET: worker-cf/src/sources/mpt/us/cboe-vix.ts:4–5, :11).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.END_OF_FOLLOWING_MONTH_CONSERVATIVE: known_at = the earlier of the capture instant and 00:00 CST on the 1st of the month after next (the month after the data month ends); a value captured before that bound is known at its capture (basis OBSERVED_AT_INGESTION). KG worker-cf/scripts/cycle-readings/lib/macro-data/catalog.cjs:197–202; V6 src/macro-data/catalog.js:198–203.
pitSemanticsDefinitions.CLOSE_DATED_NEXT_OPEN_USABLE: History without a stored known_at: a row is dated at its trade-date close (15:00 CST) and usable from the next session's open only, disclosed (coordinator ruling 2026-11-17 on #369 for V6 daily_basic and adj_factor history; the same convention as the P-14 backfill ruling).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.NEXT_DAY_0000_CST: Cycle Atlas T1 for date-only official figures: a figure of day D captured at or after D+1 00:00 CST (a late run, a backfill, history) is stamped D+1 00:00 CST; a live capture before that, not before the same-day floor, is first public when first seen (OBSERVED_AT); a backfill captured earlier waits for a later capture. KG worker-cf/src/sources/mpt/cn/common.ts:105–115 (firstPublicT1).
pitSemanticsDefinitions.FX_NEW_YORK_CLOSE: known_at = 22:00:00Z on the labelled FX date (06:00 CST the next calendar day), all year round. FXCM's daily bar closes at 17:00 New York, 21:00Z in summer and 22:00Z in winter; the producer stamps 22:00:00Z in both, so in summer the stamp is one hour after the close. Ashare-V6 src/macro-data/catalog.js:190–194 (knownAtFor), bound to USDCNH.FXCM at catalog.js:86–91; public-clock.js:101 lists it as a definitional clock.
